articles.title: GAME DAY: Islanders vs. Preds, October 27
Noah Kahan, George Kittle cheer on Predators
Capitals Loan Mitch Gibson to Hershey

away.summary: The Capitals (7-4-0) are projected to start Charlie Lindgren in net after Logan Thompson made 23 saves in a 5-2 win over the Philadelphia Flyers on Wednesday. Vincent Desharnais (appendectomy) and Rasmus Sandin (knee) are listed as injured, while Ethen Frank, Dylan McIlrath, and Ivan Miroshnichenko are scratched.

returning: detail: healthy scratch the past two games, will return to the lineup
home.summary: The Predators (4-3-5) are projected to start Juuse Saros, with Justus Annunen listed as the backup. Vitali Pinchuk returns to the lineup after being a healthy scratch for the past two games, while Daemon Hunt, Ilya Lyubushkin, and Reid Schaefer are scratched.
